findings.claim: The change rewrites constraint C-01 to permit batched/deferred regeneration and then immediately relies on that new allowance to defer its own generator-consumed source edits, and the amended text is internally contradictory: the new deferral clause permits in-phase batching while the final sentence states 'a deferral that ... reaches commit/push without regenerated outputs is a violation,' which read literally prohibits committing this very diff (skill sources under skills/process/kbd-process-orchestrator/** are edited; no .claude-plugin/.agents generated outputs are regenerated anywhere in the packet).
findings.evidence: Diff hunk in .kbd-orchestrator/constraints.md replacing 'Any change that edits a source consumed by a generator must regenerate + commit the outputs' with the named-reconciliation-change batching language, combined with .refiner/artifacts/harden-uiux-routing-discovery/refinement_log.md row 'C-01 ... IN-PHASE BATCH / OPEN' and openspec/changes/harden-uiux-routing-discovery/execution.md task 2.3 ('Distribution regeneration and installed-surface parity remain explicitly owned by the later parent change reconcile-kbd-control-plane-projections') — both of which are compliant only under the constraint text introduced by this same diff.
findings.suggested_fix: Land the C-01 amendment in its own change (or ratify it independently) before any change relies on it, and resolve the contradiction by scoping the commit/push prohibition explicitly to phase-certification or distribution commits, e.g. 'a deferral that reaches a phase-certification or distribution commit/push without regenerated outputs is a violation.'

findings.claim: Canonical state marks harden-uiux-routing-discovery COMPLETE and advances exactNextCommand to '/kbd-apply add-kbd-registry-prune', directly contradicting the change's own persisted evidence, which states '/kbd-apply harden-uiux-routing-discovery remains the correct resumable command until required review, verification, and archival finish' — and the change is indeed not archived (openspec/changes/harden-uiux-routing-discovery/ is still active while only repair-kbd-memory-rest-contract was moved to archive/). An agent following the canonical waypoint will skip this change's remaining adversarial re-review, OpenSpec verification, and archival.
findings.evidence: current-waypoint.json sets "exactNextCommand": "/kbd-apply add-kbd-registry-prune" and phases/kbd-control-plane-recovery/progress.json sets harden-uiux-routing-discovery "status": "DONE" with changes_completed: 2, while openspec/changes/harden-uiux-routing-discovery/execution.md ('Adversarial review remediation' section) and .refiner/artifacts/harden-uiux-routing-discovery/refinement_log.md ('Verdict: ... Proceed to the bounded adversarial re-review, OpenSpec verification, and archival') both assert the change is not finished.
findings.suggested_fix: Either complete review/verification/archival for harden-uiux-routing-discovery before advancing the waypoint, or keep exactNextCommand pointed at /kbd-apply harden-uiux-routing-discovery and the change status non-DONE until its remaining gates finish; make the execution evidence and the canonical ledger agree.

findings.claim: The new review-receipt exclusion silently no-ops if PHASE or TARGET is empty or unset — REVIEW_PATH interpolates to '.kbd-orchestrator/phases//review/...', a pathspec that matches nothing, with no validation and no post-check that anything was actually excluded — reintroducing the recursive re-review failure the change exists to fix, with no diagnostic.
findings.evidence: Hunk: REVIEW_PATH=".kbd-orchestrator/phases/$PHASE/review/$TARGET" followed by git diff/show invocations with ":(exclude)$REVIEW_PATH/**" and 2>/dev/null plus '|| true' on the primary diff path; there is no guard that PHASE/TARGET are non-empty in diff mode and no verification that the exclusion matched any path.
findings.suggested_fix: In diff mode, fail fast when PHASE or TARGET is empty (e.g. '[ -n "$PHASE" ] && [ -n "$TARGET" ] || exit 2'), and after building diff.patch optionally verify exclusion by checking that no diff header references $REVIEW_PATH, warning or exiting if one appears.
